description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5995012421952 CABLE ASSEMBLY,RADI: Line 0001 Qty 3 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0078 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 1. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 06129 G274627-11; 21530 G274627-11; 3B150 G274627-11; 54X10 G274627-11. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
